shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a green shirt sits in the sideboard-side window seat and asks about tea preferences, a woman in an orange shirt sits in the patio-side window seat, a woman in a white shirt sits in the sideboard-side aisle seat, and a man in a blue shirt sits in the patio-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the patio doors end, looking along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the sideboard in frame.

shots.content: A man in a green shirt and a woman in an orange shirt exchange seats, and she states a preference for plain tea.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in an orange shirt criticizes adding sugar to tea.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the sideboard-side window seat.

shots.content: A man in a green shirt replies with a defense of formal tea etiquette.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the dining table.
